name: eBay used AMD Instinct MI100 32GB PCIe card (ex-datacenter pull)
price_basis: USED, bare passive dual-slot PCIe card. $900 = midpoint of the $720-1,299 ask band captured 2026-10-03..14 ($720 for a 102-D34228 pull, $1,299 top-rated seller). Aftermarket fan shroud +$30-40 not included. ASKING price, not sold. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP: OBSERVED 2026-10-14. RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14.
lead_time_basis: lead_time_weeks is null because this is a secondary market priced per listing.
export_control_regime: EAR 3A001 or EAR99 (CDNA1 gfx908 below 3A090.a thresholds) + EAR 744.23 / 744.6 party screening
export_control_note: CDNA1-generation part below the 3A090.a thresholds; general EAR plus party screening applies.
notes: Best $/(GB x TB/s) in the whole used-datacenter slice: ~$22-40 per GB-s of bandwidth (32 GB HBM2, 1228 GB/s). THE ROCm TAX IS THE PRICE: gfx908 is still on the ROCm 10 compat matrix but is a maintenance-tier citizen, and MULTI-GPU IS THE LANDMINE - >1 MI100 segfaults on bare-metal Arch/ROCm; the working recipe in llama.cpp discussion #2824 is PCIe passthrough into an Ubuntu VM plus the HSA_AMD_SVM kernel option. Measured 8.32 tok/s on Llama-2-70B Q6_K across TWO cards (record comm-mi100-2x-llama2-70b-q6k-decode). Passive 300 W card; aftermarket shrouds $30-40. Read discussion #2824 BEFORE buying the second card.
